items.quote: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, the LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.
items.claim: In verse 3:15, the text says God told Moses to tell the children of Israel that the God of their fathers (the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob) had sent him. It also says this name is God's name forever and his memorial for all generations.
items.action: instructs Moses to declare his divine name and sender identity to the children of Israel
items.mechanism: divine commission and self-identification by lineage (God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob), declared as a perpetual name and memorial
